text:
Analysis: At the beginning, even if the son and daughter processes are scheduled onto the processor, they will be blocked.
If the father process is the first to be scheduled onto the processor at the beginning, then the father ⟦MC_1802c2c41c2df43e_0⟧, and can access the plate ->
the mother ⟦MC_1802c2c41c2df43e_1⟧, and blocks waiting for the plate ->
the father puts an apple in ⟦MC_c6f62f8bbe228bae_0⟧, the daughter process is woken up, and even if other processes run they will all be blocked, so it is temporarily impossible to access the critical resource (the plate) ->
the daughter ⟦MC_781c1cb01d6ef725_0⟧, accesses the plate, ⟦MC_4009822dd18c4029_0⟧, and the mother process waiting for the plate is woken up ->
the mother process accesses the plate (other processes are temporarily unable to enter the critical section) -> ...
